scope: GitHub repository metadata, both root tree listings, both full manuscript subtree listings and project metadata actually inspected. This is not a scan of every unrelated historical branch or third-party archive.
decision: No Paper3 source code is copied or executed in this audit. Standard metric identities can be independently implemented in Paper2 with this provenance. Paper2-owned prediction bytes retain their existing Paper2 licensing; do not invent a repository-wide Paper3 license.
